failure_case_protocol.executable_binding: Block7.3/7.7 must bind each slice only to existing causal/evaluator metadata; unsupported slices must be reported as not_evaluable rather than invented
failure_case_protocol.slice_thresholds: must be defined before formal Stage7 outcomes for any slice requiring a new numerical threshold

next_block.purpose: read-only bind exact Stage4 training/development manifests and implement the frozen independent/direct baselines without formal evaluation

deterministic_shared_trajectory.ADB_branch: frozen Stage6 deterministic predictive full-box ADB mapping
deterministic_shared_trajectory.communication_branch: same Stage5 analytic beam geometry using deterministic receiver angle
deterministic_shared_trajectory.trajectory_representation: shared calibrated predictor mean only; predictive covariance ignored

coordinate_training_sampler.negative_cells: uniform deterministic 1:1 negative sample matched to selected positive count
coordinate_training_sampler.positive_cells: all positive cells up to 4096 per actor/horizon

direct_ADB_predictor.encoder: GRU history encoder matched to frozen predictor encoder layer count and hidden dimension
direct_ADB_predictor.final_illumination_mapping: reuse frozen Stage6 Part-A-compatible illumination composition, class floors, temporal smoothing and actuation limits
direct_ADB_predictor.input: same causal actor history/features available to trajectory predictor
direct_ADB_predictor.joint_evaluation_role: replace ADB predictive representation only; retain frozen shared-posterior communication branch
direct_ADB_predictor.training_target: constructed future actor full-box support on training data only

direct_beam_classifier.encoder: GRU history encoder matched to the frozen predictor's encoder layer count and hidden dimension
direct_beam_classifier.input: same causal history/features available to trajectory predictor
direct_beam_classifier.joint_evaluation_role: replace communication branch only; retain frozen shared-posterior ADB branch
direct_beam_classifier.training_target: future receiver beam class on training data only

ADB_predictor.architecture: exact same Gaussian-GRU trajectory predictor architecture as shared system
ADB_predictor.downstream_mapping: same frozen Stage6 analytic posterior_to_ADB mapping

communication_predictor.architecture: exact same Gaussian-GRU trajectory predictor architecture as shared system
communication_predictor.downstream_mapping: same frozen Stage5 analytic posterior_to_beam mapping

independent_models.training_rule: same causal feature schema, same training/development partitions, same trajectory losses and same calibration protocol as the frozen trajectory predictor; only parameter sets/seeds are independent

resource_accounting.FLOPs: report where computable; analytic mappings may be declared N/A with operation semantics

direct_ADB_predictor.resource_accounting: shared communication predictor path plus direct ADB predictor

direct_beam_classifier.resource_accounting: shared ADB predictor path plus direct beam classifier

resource_accounting.total_latency_formula: sensing + preprocessing + tracking + unique predictor inference + beam selection + beam probing + ADB generation + ADB actuation

statistical_protocol.aggregation: equal-weight macro mean over finite scenario-level metric values
statistical_protocol.metric_specific_missingness: use only scenario IDs where both compared systems have finite values for that metric
statistical_protocol.paired_comparison_rule: for system A versus B, resample common scenario IDs and preserve all within-scenario paired outputs

latency.intermediate_time_semantics: causal propagation/interpolation only; NOT millisecond annotated WOMD ground truth

independent_and_direct_baselines.development_population: exact upstream Stage4 development/calibration partition only
independent_and_direct_baselines.split_manifest_binding: must be resolved read-only and SHA-frozen before Block7.3 training begins
independent_and_direct_baselines.training_population: exact upstream Stage4 training partition only

training_and_leakage_boundary.model_selection_metric: must use development population only; formal Stage7 outcomes forbidden
